rules: In the mock-a project, vitest (v2.1.9) is available in node_modules but is NOT listed in package.json devDependencies. Do NOT attempt to add vitest to package.json or run npm install — this would violate scaffold immutability. The existing import from 'vitest' in src/hello.test.ts already works because vitest is hoisted from the monorepo root. If you need to run tests, use npx vitest run or node ./node_modules/.bin/vitest run directly.
